text: Delivered in merge f0e1c70 (branch commits 56e7cf3, 345e978, e7bf0b2). plan/RecordingInput.scala (channels, observed synchronization with deterministic refit, input hash, disagreements); codec/RecordingInputCodec.scala (recording@1, binocular-recording@1, recording-input@1: column-oriented samples with decimal-string micros, typed state/lineage, finite-or-null positions, contentHash reproduced on decode -> InputIdentity, SampleBound refusal at 2^22 samples before allocation, typed SynchronizationFit disagreement); codec/TemporalInputCodec.scala (temporal-study-input@1 with inline or by-reference base study via caller-supplied resolve, typed epochs/coverage, TimelineCodecs closing the cd-codecs Timeline residual); source-supported scanpaths now encodable (centre/sampleCount exact, dispersion by method); four v1 fixtures re-encoding byte-identically on JVM; RecordingInputCodecLawSuite with four killed mutants under a strict Failed-only criterion.
